title: The Northern Lights
text: The lights in the sky come down to the ice, green and violet ribbons of them, and dance among you. They are cold, colder than the snow. They brush your faces like curious fingers. They seem to be trying to learn what you are.

outcomes.text: Light and cold joy, and laughter you did not know you had left.
Too cold. The lights leave frost where they touched.

options.label: Stand still and let them look.

outcomes.text: They pass through you, cold and curious, and something in you is lighter.
